Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
CE was available for sale at the White Wolf booth at Gen*Con.
The official release date is still August 19, however.

That means that CE cards (*all* cards with the CE expansion symbol
on them) won't be legal for VEKN constructed deck tournaments until
September 18. Marcus Vitel, the promo card, is the sole exception.
Reprints are not exceptions.

Reprints are not exceptions.

Reprints found in the CE set, like the new cards found in the CE set
are not legal for VEKN constructed deck play until September 18.

So far, two misprints have been discovered:

One of the new vampires (Elena Gutierrez, if I recall correctly) has
no group number. She is group 3 (errata).

Brachah is printed with superior potence instead of superior presence.
She has superior presence instead of superior potence (errata).

--
